title: MCDS-VSS: Structured Video Segmentation with Self-Supervised Depth & Motion
description: A structured filtering model for temporally consistent semantic segmentation of automotive video.
body: Our paper was accepted for publication at BMVC 2024.

MCDS-VSS learns depth and ego-motion in a self-supervised way and uses these representations together with estimated object motion to propagate scene features. It achieves improved temporal consistency on Cityscapes while parsing scenes into human-interpretable representations.
